title: RBI Mandates Machine Authentication & Impounding of Fake Currency in Border Branches
summary: Counters cross-border Fake Indian Currency Notes (FICN) smuggling and preserves cash integrity.

blocks.content: Counters cross-border Fake Indian Currency Notes (FICN) smuggling and preserves cash integrity.

items: Note authentication and sorting machines mandatory in all bank branches in **districts sharing international borders**.
**100% of received banknotes** must be machine-examined for authenticity.
**Impounding Mandate:** Counterfeit notes **must be impounded immediately** — returning or destroying fake notes at the bank is strictly illegal.

blocks.title: Static Background & GK Context
blocks.summary: Note printing presses at Mysuru, Salboni, Dewas, Nashik | Mints at Mumbai, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Noida.

blocks.title: Exam Trap & Statutory Distinction
blocks.content: Returning or destroying a fake note is illegal — banks must impound it and issue an acknowledgement receipt.

blocks.quote:
Interview Focus Question: "Can a bank branch return a suspected counterfeit note to a customer?"
💡 **Model Answer: No, regulations strictly mandate immediate impounding to prevent fake notes from re-entering cash circulation.**
